label: Client API requests (history)
purpose: Daily history of requests clients send to the booking engine API (almost all XML): volumes by request type and outcome, hotels requested and returned, response times and sizes, and look-to-book. Covers 2025-10-16 to yesterday; today is in Statistics Real Time Client.
grain: Client API requests aggregated per day and hour, customer, request type, outcome (error type), interface, integrator context, availability/package type, warning and response-time band.
use_for: client API request volumes and trends since October 2025
look-to-book ratio by customer, integrator or market
API outcomes: correct, no results, errors (too many requests, invalid dates...)
API response times and response sizes
hotels requested and returned per API request
not_for: "searches" (Statistics Zone [Total Requests]) except for periods before 2026-07-18 (see review)
B2B web portal traffic (Statistics Client Web)

coverage.note: Daily from 2025-10-16 to yesterday (UAE date); today's traffic is only in Statistics Real Time Client.

dates.label: Request date
dates.meaning: Day the request was received, UAE time (the cube's main date).

dates.label: Request date (CET)
dates.meaning: The same request date in Central European Time (the engine's server time); differs from the UAE date for requests made around midnight. Use only when CET is asked for.

dates.label: Last-year helper date (CET)
dates.meaning: Last-year helper: each CET date shifted one year back. Never filter questions on it.

dates.label: Last-year helper date, weekday-aligned (CET)
dates.meaning: Last-year helper aligned on the same weekday a year back. Never filter questions on it.

measures.name: [% Hotel Results]
measures.label: API hotel result rate
measures.definition: Hotels returned as a share of hotels requested in client API requests ([Hotel Results] / [Hotels Request]).

measures.name: [% L2B]
measures.label: Look-to-book %
measures.definition: Bookings as a share of availability requests: the inverse of [L2B] (1 / [L2B]), a tiny percentage.
measures.notes: Verified: [L2B] x [% L2B] = 1. Breaks when filtered or grouped by request type.

measures.name: [AVG Hotel Results]
measures.label: Hotel results per API request
measures.definition: Average hotels returned per client API request ([Hotel Results] / [Requests]).

measures.name: [AVG Hotels Request]
measures.label: Hotels per API request
measures.definition: Average hotels asked for per client API request ([Hotels Request] / [Requests]).

measures.name: [AVG Response Time Sec]
measures.label: API average response time
measures.definition: Average time the engine took to answer a client API request, in seconds (the period).
measures.notes: The cube's own format shows no decimals; typical value is about 0.5 s.

measures.name: [AVG Size Bytes Response]
measures.label: API average response size (bytes)
measures.definition: Average response size per API request in bytes.
measures.hidden_reason: duplicate of [AVG Size Kb Response] in bytes

measures.name: [AVG Size Kb Response]
measures.label: API average response size
measures.definition: Average response size per client API request in KB (bytes / 1024).

measures.name: [Hotel Results]
measures.label: API hotels returned
measures.definition: Number of hotels returned with availability in client API responses.

measures.name: [Hotels Request]
measures.label: API hotels requested
measures.definition: Number of hotels asked for inside client API requests (about 5 per availability request).

measures.name: [L2B]
measures.label: Look-to-book ratio
measures.definition: Availability requests per booking (about 613,000 availability requests for each booking over the last year).
measures.notes: Formula not published; verified that grouped by request type it returns the availability requests, so it is availability requests / bookings.

measures.name: [Max Response Time Sec]
measures.label: API maximum response time
measures.definition: Longest time taken to answer a single client API request, in seconds; capped by the engine time-out.

measures.name: [Requests]
measures.label: API requests
measures.definition: Number of requests clients sent to the booking engine API, all request types (availability, cancellation policy, hotel information, booking, cancel...); 99.99% through the XML interface.

measures.name: [Size Bytes Response]
measures.label: API response data (bytes)
measures.definition: Total size of API responses in bytes.
measures.hidden_reason: duplicate of [Size Gb Response] in bytes

measures.name: [Size Gb Response]
measures.label: API response data volume
measures.definition: Total size of client API responses in GB (binary: bytes / 1024^3).

measures.name: [Size Kb Response]
measures.label: API response data (KB)
measures.definition: Total size of API responses in KB.
measures.hidden_reason: duplicate of [Size Gb Response] in KB

measures.name: [Size Mb Response]
measures.label: API response data (MB)
measures.definition: Total size of API responses in MB.
measures.hidden_reason: duplicate of [Size Gb Response] in MB

rules: "Searches" are answered by Statistics Zone [Total Requests]. Use [Requests] here for API requests of all types, and for availability requests only where Statistics Zone has no data (before 2026-07-18), saying which source is used.
Data runs to yesterday; for today use Statistics Real Time Client.
[Max Response Time Sec] tops out at the engine time-out (180 s).

[L2B] = availability requests per booking and [% L2B] = 1 / [L2B]. Both are ratios: never add them, and never filter or group them by request type ('Tipo Peticion'): that breaks the ratio (it then just returns the availability requests).
Averages ([AVG ...]) and [Max Response Time Sec] must be asked from the cube at the level needed; never sum or average them across rows.

Filter days on 'Calendario'[Fecha] (UAE time). 'Fecha'[Fecha] and 'Date CET'[Date CET] are flat copies of 'Calendario'[Fecha] and 'Calendar CET'[Date CET] with identical data; do not use them. Never use the 'Calendario' columns ending in '.Value' (they fail: composite key).
'Solicitante' holds requester IP addresses: technical, never group by it.
[Size Gb Response] is binary GB (bytes / 1024^3); the bytes/KB/MB size measures are hidden duplicates.
Show response times with 2 decimals (the cube's own format rounds them to whole seconds).
Use the cube's measures only; never SUM a column.

review.question: Does "look-to-book" mean Statistics History Client [L2B] (availability requests per booking, about 613,000:1 over the last year)?
options: Statistics Hotel Client [L2B] (hotel-level requests per booking, about 2,000,000:1)
review.why: It is the request-level ratio, covers all clients and has the longest history (from 2025-10-16). Hotel Client counts every hotel inside a search and starts 2026-08-17. Supplier-side look-to-book belongs to the supplier cubes.

review.question: Does plain "requests" / "API requests" mean Statistics History Client [Requests] (all API request types), while "searches" stays Statistics Zone [Total Requests]?
review.why: History Client counts every API call type (availability, cancellation policy, hotel information, booking...) with 12 months of history; Statistics Zone starts 2026-07-18 and is the agreed source for searches.
